title: 등산 영상에 찍힌 빨간 옷의 소녀
disclaimer: 실제 보도·기록 기반 | 초자연 현상은 전해지는 이야기입니다

jumpscare.img: close-up of a little girl in a red hood whose face is completely hidden in deep black shadow, no visible eyes, dark forest

lines.img: a misty mountain forest hiking trail in Taiwan, dense subtropical trees, overcast

lines.text: 타이중 다컹 산. 한 가족의 등산 영상입니다.
lines.img: a Taiwanese family of hikers walking up a forest mountain trail seen from behind, 1998
happy Taiwanese family hikers smiling and waving on a mountain path, 1990s home video

lines.text: 그런데 돌아온 직후, 일행 한 명이 세상을 떠납니다.
lines.img: a traditional Taiwanese funeral altar at night with white chrysanthemums, candles and incense smoke, dim

lines.text: 장례식 날, 가족들은 그 테이프를 다시 틀었습니다.
lines.img: an old CRT television glowing in a dark room, a VHS tape being inserted into a VCR, silhouettes of mourners watching
an old CRT television in a dark 1990s Taiwanese living room showing a TV broadcast with static, eerie glow

lines.text: 일행 맨 뒤를 따라오는, 빨간 옷의 여자아이.
lines.img: a little girl in a red dress standing alone between dark trees in fog, watching, face in shadow

lines.text: 그날 산에서, 그 아이를 본 사람은 아무도 없었다고 합니다.
lines.img: a small girl in a bright red dress and red hat standing far behind a group of hikers on a misty forest trail, distant, blurry, unsettling

lines.text: 얼굴은 늘 그림자에 가려, 눈이 보이지 않았죠.
lines.img: a shadowy figure in a red hooded cloak emerging from pitch darkness, face hidden, only glowing pale chin visible, horror film

lines.text: 대만에는 이런 말이 있습니다. 산에서 누가 부르면, 절대 대답하지 말라.
lines.img: an empty misty mountain forest path at dusk in Taiwan, nobody there, eerie silence
a dark forest at night seen over someone's shoulder, a tiny red figure far away between the trees
